# KDBG security reporting

Report vulnerabilities privately at:

https://github.com/yunttai/KDBG/security/advisories/new

The assigned security owner is `yunttai`. Include the affected KDBG version,
main and symbols ZIP SHA-256 values, Windows build, VM/hypervisor details,
reproduction steps, expected and observed behavior, and the smallest redacted
diagnostic set that demonstrates the issue.

Do not open a public issue containing exploit details, credentials, raw memory,
or an unredacted crash dump. The public issue chooser at
https://github.com/yunttai/KDBG/issues/new/choose is for non-sensitive support.

Private vulnerability reporting is enabled, but notification delivery and an
end-to-end submission/acknowledgement drill have not yet been verified. Their
absence keeps the commercial-operations gate fail-closed; this policy file alone
does not assert commercial readiness.

Repository security settings currently include secret scanning, secret-scanning
push protection, vulnerability alerts, and Dependabot security updates.
